text:
Design review. Polished diagram — load balancer, API, cache, DB, queue.

My tech lead: "What happens when Redis goes down?"

Cache was on the slide. Nothing about fail-open, fail-closed, or stampeding Postgres.

Solid vs dashed arrows, read vs write, one failure note — that's what I add now before adding another box.
